subject: Exec recap: Redwood Inference pilot discussion with SilverlineTech
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harrell <tom.harrell@silverlinetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec recap: Redwood Inference pilot discussion with SilverlineTech

Tom — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick executive recap from our call and proposed next steps so your leadership and procurement teams have a single note.

Key business outcomes you shared:
- Reduce average customer support response time by 40% through automated summarization + suggested replies.
- Improve search relevancy for knowledge base articles to cut deflection lift by 25%.
- Maintain response quality comparable to senior support staff (QA thresholds: >92% relevance).

Primary pain points:
- Current vendor is inconsistent on latency at peak (5-7s token latency causing poor UX).
- Rising inference cost at scale; need predictable unit economics for budgeting.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 report and audit logs required for procurement.

What Redwood will deliver in the pilot (MVP scope attached):
- 6-week pilot using a mid-sized model (configurable) serving through a dedicated pool; expected p95 latency < 200ms for target flows.
- Integration plan: embed endpoint for KB search + generate suggestion API.
- Measurement plan: weekly dashboards for latency, cost per 1k tokens, and quality metrics based on your evaluation prompts.

Mutual action plan / next steps:
1) Share SOC2 report + security docs (we attached SOC2_overview.pdf). ACTION: Laura (Redwood) - done.
2) Silverline to confirm success metrics and pilot contacts. ACTION: Tom - by 6/2.
3) Schedule executive alignment call (30 min) to include your VP of Support and our Head of Solutions. ACTION: Laura/Marissa - propose slots.
4) Procurement path: draft PO or MSA? ACTION: Priya/Procurement to confirm timeline and required legal redlines.

Attachments: Silverline_MVP_scope_v1.pdf, SOC2_overview.pdf

If helpful I can prepare a 1-page executive summary for your CFO prior to procurement. Proposed exec call times tomorrow (6/1): 09:00-09:30 PT, 11:00-11:30 PT, 15:00-15:30 PT. Let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Silverline_MVP_scope_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 145KB)

From: Tom Harrell <tom.harrell@silverlinetech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec recap: Redwood Inference pilot discussion with SilverlineTech

Laura - thanks for the clear recap, this is exactly what I need to bring to Priya and our VP of Support. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: Priya prefers an MSA + SOW for pilots, but she asked for a rough PO timeline. We’re targeting a procurement decision by mid-June (aiming to have signatures by 6/15).
- Security: can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for production? Also want to review SOC2 details - appreciate the attachment.
- Pricing: Can you provide a ballpark for the 6-week pilot (est. token volume in scope: 50M tokens)? We need something exec-friendly for the finance team (high/medium/low scenarios).

I’ll pull in Priya on the thread for procurement specifics. We also want to ensure there’s an escalation contact in case we hit quality regressions during pilot.

Thanks - I’ll review the scope doc and get back with our preferred exec call time.

Tom Harrell
Head of Support Operations
SilverlineTech
Tom.Harrell@silverlinetech.com | (212) 555-0188

--
Attachment request: SOC2_overview.pdf

Tom - great, appreciate the quick reply. Short answers and immediate next steps below.

- KMS: Yes - Redwood supports customer-managed KMS in private deployments and can offer KMS integration options for Dedicated (we noted this as a requirement in the scope). I’ll loop in our security lead if you want deeper technical details.
- Pilot pricing: Marissa is putting together three scenarios (low/med/high) based on the 50M token estimate. Marissa - can you share a deck with pilot pricing and an estimated committed throughput so Tom/Priya have numbers for finance?
- Escalation contact: Sean will be your primary escalation owner during the pilot (technical & quality issues). Sean - please confirm availability.

Proposed exec alignment call: Tue 6/1 11:00-11:30 PT (tentative). I’ll send an invite once Tom confirms.

Mutual action plan (updated):
- Laura: send SOC2 + scope (done).
- Marissa: pilot pricing scenarios + SOW template (by 6/1 EOD).
- Priya: confirm procurement path (MSA + SOW or PO) and desired contract terms (by 6/2).
- Sean: escalation contact and onboarding support plan (confirm availability).

Marissa - can you share the pricing scenarios and a draft SOW by EOD Monday (6/1)? Sean - please confirm scope for support coverage during pilot (on-call hours and P1 response SLA).
